notes: Two linear windings, L1 = L2 = 10 mH, k = 0.9 (M = 9 mH), dots at plus1/plus2; primary driven through 10 ohm by a 1 V step, secondary loaded by 100 ohm. Hand estimate before the first run: at the step di1/dt = V*L2/(L1*L2 - M^2) = 526 A/s and di2/dt = -(M/L2)*di1/dt, so the current INTO plus2 goes NEGATIVE (the secondary drives current out of its dotted end into the load). Polarity is the sign; the 1 mA bound is a loading floor (an open secondary stays near zero). Energy: the load dissipates what the coupling transfers; the account must close.
